name: JustIdea Agency public API
description:
JustIdea Agency (justidea.agency) is a Polish e-commerce and performance marketing agency from Kraków: online stores (PrestaShop, WooCommerce), websites, SEO, paid ads, analytics, content and branding.

This API is **read-only** and exposes only what is published on the website. It never submits forms, books meetings or sends messages: to get in touch, give the user the contact link, e-mail address or phone number from `GET /api/v1/contact`. The same data is available over MCP at https://justidea.agency/mcp.

**Authentication.** None required. An optional OAuth 2.1 bearer token (scope `site:read`, see https://justidea.agency/auth.md) identifies the agent and raises the rate limit. An invalid or expired token gets `401` with a `WWW-Authenticate` header pointing at https://justidea.agency/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource; `GET /api/v1/identity` always needs a token.

**Rate limits.** 120 requests per 60 seconds per IP address, 600 per agent with a token. Every response carries `RateLimit-Policy` (IETF RateLimit header fields) and `X-RateLimit-Limit`. A `429` carries `Retry-After` (seconds) and `RateLimit` with the remaining quota (0). A batch counts as one request.

**Errors.** Every 4xx and 5xx response is `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance` and a machine-readable `code`. Each `type` URI points at its section of https://justidea.agency/api.md.

**Pagination.** `GET /api/v1/pages` is cursor-based: pass `next_cursor` from the response as `cursor` until it is `null`. The next page is also in the `Link: <...>; rel="next"` header. Cursors are opaque.

**Versioning and deprecation.** The major version is in the path (`/api/v1`). Within v1 changes are additive only: new endpoints, new optional parameters, new response fields. Clients must ignore unknown fields. A breaking change ships as `/api/v2`; v1 then keeps working and its responses carry a `Deprecation` header (RFC 9745) from the day the decision is made and a `Sunset` header (RFC 8594) with the removal date, at least 90 days later. `info.version` follows SemVer.

**Batch and retries.** `POST /api/v1/batch` runs up to 10 GET operations in one request. All operations are read-only and have no side effects, so every request, including a batch, is safe to retry. An optional `Idempotency-Key` header on the batch is accepted and echoed back.

All prices are net starting prices (VAT excluded) as published on the website: PLN on Polish pages, EUR on English pages. The final quote depends on scope.
